# kion_ou_note (Resource)

Manages a Kion OU Note.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_ou_note" "example" {
  # Required
  create_user_id = 1
  name           = "example"
  ou_id          = 1
  text           = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `create_user_id` (Number) ID of the user creating the note.
- `name` (String) Name of the OU note.
- `ou_id` (Number) ID of the OU this note belongs to.
- `text` (String) Text content of the OU note.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) OU Note ID.
